summary: This week in AI, significant advancements were made in watermarking technology, with Anthropic and Google introducing new methods to identify AI-generated content. OpenAI and Anthropic are also engaged in a price war, while IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster its enterprise AI push. Meanwhile, concerns about AI safety and ethics continue to grow.
insight: The increasing focus on watermarking and AI safety highlights the need for responsible AI development and deployment, as the technology becomes more pervasive in everyday life.
